content: Chrome Web Store: MV3 forbids remotely hosted code (Blue Argon rejection; reviewers inspect compiled bundle incl. transitive deps); narrowest permissions; single narrow purpose; no obfuscation; privacy policy + prominent disclosure + limited use. Policy update enforced from 2026-08-01: collected data must be strictly necessary to the disclosed single purpose, all collection prominently disclosed, post-install changes disclosed, and new ban on extensions designed to circumvent safety guardrails/usage restrictions of AI services. Context: Dec 2025 extensions harvesting AI chat conversations removed. Impersonation policy: no implying endorsement by another company; minimum functionality: no extension whose single purpose is launching another app; 2SV required.
